tools.name: get_pcb_stack_layers
tools.description: Return the current PCB copper layer count and active signal routing layers. Open the target PCB document first and inspect this before writing router DSL layer constraints.

tools.name: import_pcb_changes
tools.description: Import schematic changes into the currently opened PCB document. If schematic_uuid is omitted, EasyEDA uses the schematic linked to the same board. Open the target PCB document first. For PCB docs, read the local docs folder: /pkg/node_modules/easyeda-copilot-mcp/docs/SKILL.md

schematic_uuid.description: Optional schematic UUID to import changes from.

tools.name: get_pcb_component_sizes
tools.description: Return resolved PCB footprint sizes in millimeters for selected current schematic components. Use before choosing compact board dimensions. For PCB layout docs, read the local docs folder: /pkg/node_modules/easyeda-copilot-mcp/docs/SKILL.md

tools.name: make_pcb_layout
tools.description: Create PCB component placement from a JavaScript DSL file. Open the target PCB first so its outline and component positions are supplied as existingPlacement. Long work returns an operation_id for wait_operation. This tool does not assemble or route the board. For PCB layout docs, read: /pkg/node_modules/easyeda-copilot-mcp/docs/SKILL.md

file.description: Path to a JavaScript PCB layout DSL code file.

wait_ms.description: Initial synchronous wait before returning a pcb-layout operation_id.

tools.name: assemble_pcb_layout_on_current_pcbdoc
tools.description: Send a previously generated make_pcb_layout board assembly payload to the currently opened EasyEDA PCB document. Runs as a managed operation, waits up to 50 seconds, and always returns operation_id. Before using this tool, call get_current_project_info, verify the schematic belongs to a BOARD item with a PCB document, and call open_document for that PCB uuid. For PCB assembly docs, read the local docs folder: /pkg/node_modules/easyeda-copilot-mcp/docs/SKILL.md

tools.name: preview_pcb
tools.description: Render a PNG preview of the currently opened PCB document from PCB primitives using the Copilot renderer. Requires EasyEDA 3+. Supports layer filtering and custom highlight colors. Returns image_path and notes. This preview does not verify actual filled copper. Open the target PCB document first.

layers.description: Layers to render, e.g. ["TOP"], ["BOTTOM"], ["TOP","BOTTOM"], or ["all"]. Use uppercase layer names; only "all" is lowercase.

zoom.description: Zoom target: full board, a net, a component, or a bbox.

designator.description: Component designator to zoom to, e.g. U1.

x.description: Relative X (0..1) of the board bounding box.

y.description: Relative Y (0..1) of the board bounding box.

width.description: Relative width (0..1) of the board bounding box.

height.description: Relative height (0..1) of the board bounding box.

bbox.description: Bounding box in mm or relative units.

padding_mm.description: Padding around the rendered area in millimeters.

tools.name: inspect_net
tools.description: Inspect a net on the open PCB. Returns one net summary: net, found, pads (net membership), layer, length (sum of line and arc lengths), vias (count), width (min/max, or null without tracks), segments (line and arc count), optional bbox of tracks/vias, polygons (source outlines), and drc (violation_count, truncated, violations). MULTI denotes through vias. Read connection failures in native drc.violations; no connections are inferred from geometry. Includes unrouted and via-only nets. Open the target PCB document first.

drc_limit.description: Maximum returned native DRC details for this net, after net filtering. violation_count uses the full matching result.

tools.name: inspect_component
tools.description: Return a PCB component by designator with a list of nearest neighboring components within the given radius. Open the target PCB document first.

designator.description: Component designator to inspect, e.g. R1.

radius.description: Search radius in millimeters for nearest components.

tools.name: get_current_pcb
tools.description: Read a PCB overview from native primitives through the connected MCP interface; not an atomic revision snapshot. Open a PCB document first. Coordinates are mm in the native PCB frame, not the normalized routing frame. For edits, resolve exact primitive IDs and reread their native poses. wires contains copper statistics grouped by net; pads lists net membership; polygons are source outlines, not rebuilt fill geometry. Use native DRC for connectivity. Responses over 8 KiB are saved to a file.

tools.name: run_pcb_router_dsl
tools.description: Apply DRC, copper-only, or routing intent from an eda-copilot-router DSL file to the currently opened EasyEDA PCB. Long work returns an operation_id for wait_operation. PCB instructions: /pkg/node_modules/easyeda-copilot-mcp/docs/SKILL.md. Authoritative router DSL declarations: /pkg/node_modules/eda-copilot-router/docs/routing-dsl.d.ts

file.description: Path to a JavaScript PCB routing DSL file.

wait_ms.description: Initial synchronous wait before returning a pcb-dsl operation_id.

tools.name: list_checkpoints
tools.description: List saved checkpoints with names, newest first. Defaults to 16; use limit to include older checkpoints.

tools.name: save_checkpoint_for_current_page
tools.description: Save a checkpoint for the current EasyEDA document. Give it a short descriptive name for recovery; only describe checks as passed after verification. Restore by the returned ID, even when names match.

tools.name: restore_checkpoint_for_current_page
tools.description: Restore one checkpoint by id in EasyEDA.

tools.name: library_list
tools.description: List component libraries supported by the backend. Explicit public library UUIDs are also accepted by component_search.

tools.name: component_search
tools.description: Search EasyEDA devices. library_uuid defaults to lcsc; use library_list to discover aliases. Search results include a ready-to-use part_uuid. Components with any ambiguous pin name may have preview_recommended and a local preview_image_path. Skip preview for one-pin parts, ordinary two-pin resistors, simple inductors and fuses, and parts with clear pin names. Capacitors are not exempt. Inspect only the selected uncertain candidate; do not review every result or repeat a completed review. Rendering failures leave the component in the result with preview_error.

library_uuid.description: Library alias or explicit public library UUID. Defaults to lcsc.

tools.name: preview_component
tools.description: Render every section of an EasyEDA library schematic symbol with visible pin numbers. Returns only image_path for the generated PNG; no image is attached.

tools.name: extract_circuit_on_current_page
tools.description: Apply circuit changes to the current EasyEDA page. Every added component must include part_uuid. The result reports remaining current-sheet space and warns below 10%. Runs as a managed operation, waits up to 50 seconds, and always returns operation_id. For circuit modification docs, read: /pkg/node_modules/easyeda-copilot-mcp/docs/SKILL.md

value.description: Minimum description: for simple components — only the nominal value; for microcircuits — only the name. Only ASCII symbols (e.g., "LM358", "10nF", "100k").

signal_name.description: The name of the signal the pin is connected to. (Name only). The signal name assigned to the pin must be identical to the signal name of the target output.

port_style.description: Optional appearance of a generated net port at this connection. Ignored for power and ground.

search_query.description: A component search question. For example: "1k 1W smd resistor", "LM358", "2-pin power connector"

parameters_to_recalc.description: Parameters that will be recalculated to suit your needs

rm_components.description: Components to remove from the circuit

external_rm_connect.description: Use only if you need to remove/break the connection from an external component's pin. Remember to remove external_rm_connect first and then add external_connect.

external_connect.description: Use only when you need to connect to a pin of an external component that you have not modified and that does not have a signal_name

file_path.description: Path to a UTF-8 JSON file containing CircuitMod. Provide either file_path or inline circuit fields.

tools.name: beautify_schematic_on_current_page
tools.description: Reassemble every component on the current EasyEDA schematic page into named functional blocks. The blocks must cover the whole page. A checkpoint is saved before replacement, and failures restore it automatically. Runs as a managed operation, waits up to 50 seconds, and always returns operation_id. For circuit workflow docs, read: /pkg/node_modules/easyeda-copilot-mcp/docs/SKILL.md

blocks.description: All current-page components grouped by block name.

draw_block_box.description: Draw Copilot-managed boxes and labels around functional blocks.

auto_resize_page.description: Shrink or grow the schematic drawing sheet to the smallest standard format that fits the layout inside its frame and title block.

tools.name: get_schematic
tools.description: Get the current EasyEDA schematic page, or all pages with get_full_schematic. Responses over 8 KiB are saved to a file.

get_full_schematic.description: Get Full Schematic: retrieve the schematic from all pages.

tools.name: get_schematic_groups
tools.description: Read the current schematic page and return heuristic component groups plus direct non-ground wire islands. Set get_full_schematic_groups to concatenate page-local results from every schematic page. maybe_blocks and wires[].pins contain space-separated references; groups may omit singleton or ambiguous components. errors contains non-fatal diagnostics when the result is partial. Use get_schematic for values, pin names and the electrical netlist.

get_full_schematic_groups.description: Read and concatenate schematic groups from every page in the current schematic.

tools.name: annotate_designators
tools.description: Annotate component designators across every page of the current EasyEDA schematic. Prefixes are preserved exactly; only trailing numbers are assigned. Multi-part component sections are renamed together. Runs as a managed operation, waits up to 50 seconds, and always returns operation_id.

mode.description: preserve changes only duplicate or unnumbered designators; resequence recalculates every trailing number in page and position order.

tools.name: open_document
tools.description: Open either a project or a document by UUID. Before switching projects, every open EasyEDA schematic, PCB, and panel tab is saved; the switch is aborted if any save fails.

project_uuid.description: Project UUID from get_all_projects or create_doc.

tools.name: save_doc
tools.description: Save the currently active EasyEDA schematic, PCB, or panel document.

tools.name: sync_current_document
tools.description: Force EasyEDA to synchronize the current schematic or PCB document by saving it, closing the current editor tab, waiting briefly, and reopening the same document.

settle_ms.description: Delay in milliseconds between close and reopen.

tools.name: modify_name
tools.description: Modify the name of an EasyEDA Schematic, Schematic page, PCB

uuid.description: Schematic, Schematic page or PCB UUID.

name.description: New short name. Use UPPERCASE or PascalCase

tools.name: create_doc
tools.description: Create a project, or create a document in the current EasyEDA project. Project creation uses an experimental EasyEDA beta API and does not open the new project.

schematic_uuid.description: Optional schematic UUID to link to the new board.

pcb_uuid.description: Optional PCB UUID to link to the new board.

project_name.description: Optional unique identifier containing only ASCII letters, digits, and hyphens.

team_uuid.description: Optional team UUID. Omit for a personal project.

tools.name: delete_doc
tools.description: Delete a doc from the current EasyEDA project. This is destructive!

uuid.description: Schematic, Schematic page or PCB UUID.

tools.name: get_current_project_info
tools.description: Read the current EasyEDA project tree and document metadata through the connected extension. BOARD items show the linked schematic and PCB document; use this before PCB assembly.

tools.name: get_pcb_drc_rules
tools.description: Return a compact routing-relevant view of the current EasyEDA PCB DRC rules: global limits, net classes, differential pairs, equal-length groups, and explicit net overrides. Open the target PCB document first.

tools.name: check_pcb_drc
tools.description: Run native EasyEDA PCB DRC on the open PCB. Returns compact grouped violations with full counts, truncated: true only when details are omitted, object labels, messages, primitive_ids, rule_name and layer when supplied by EasyEDA. Resolve primitive_ids through the PCB API before editing. Does not rebuild pours. The detail budget is shared across groups per category, with at least one item per nonempty group. Open the target PCB document first.

limit.description: Maximum number of violations to return per category, split across rule groups.

tools.name: list_easyeda_instances
tools.description: List connected EasyEDA instances. Use when more than one window or project may be open.

tools.name: select_easyeda_instance
tools.description: Select which connected EasyEDA project this MCP process should use when multiple EasyEDA instances are connected.

tools.name: list_operations
tools.description: Discover active and recently completed operations in this MCP process, including IDs lost when an initial wait was cancelled. Returns compact status, stage and target metadata.

tools.name: wait_operation
tools.description: Wait for a running mutation, PCB layout or PCB router DSL operation. Running router responses include up to 10 recent log lines and their update time when available.

wait_ms.description: Wait below the common 60-second MCP request timeout.

tools.name: cancel_operation
tools.description: Request cooperative cancellation of a running operation. Cancellation is not rollback.

tools.name: apply_operation
tools.description: Retry applying a prepared in-memory operation result without running the operation again.

tools.name: get_all_projects
tools.description: Read all directly accessible EasyEDA teams, folders, and projects as a nested project tree.

tools.name: execute_js
tools.description: Execute JavaScript in the selected EasyEDA window using code OR an absolute file_path. Code limit: 64 MiB. Optional input_files supplies named UTF-8 strings as inputs[name], up to 512 MiB combined. Automatically checkpoints the current document before execution. Execution budget is 60 seconds; native actions may outlive cancellation or timeout. Runs as a managed operation, waits up to 50 seconds, and always returns operation_id. Returns {checkpoint,result,artifacts}; binary and oversized results are saved as local files. Read /pkg/node_modules/easyeda-copilot-mcp/docs/execution/instructions.md for the contract and API reference. For local Python/Node.js computation with await eda.* proxies and native binary values, read /pkg/node_modules/easyeda-copilot-mcp/docs/execution/local-sdk.md.

code.description: JavaScript async-function body. Use return for the result; await all changes.

file_path.description: Absolute path to a UTF-8 JavaScript file on the MCP host. Alternative to code.

input_files.description: Named UTF-8 files on the MCP host, available as inputs[name]. Absolute paths; combined maximum 512 MiB. Data is passed separately from code.
